data.name: AmbiguousOverload
data.value: This call matches more than one overload of {0}, so Oracle can't run it (PLS-00307).
data.comment: {0} is a subprogram name.

data.name: BreakpointHasNoCode
data.value: Line {0} of {1} has no code to stop at.
data.comment: {0} is a line number, {1} a unit name.

data.name: CannotPassType
data.value: TablePro can't pass any value of type {0} to {1}.
data.comment: {0} is a PL/SQL type name, {1} a parameter name.

data.name: CannotPassTypeDetail
data.value: Debug it from a routine that calls it with that value.

data.name: CompileForDebug
data.value: TablePro compiles it again with debug information (PLSQL_OPTIMIZE_LEVEL=1) and keeps its other settings. Compiling commits.

data.name: CompileForDebugAction
data.value: Compile for Debug
data.comment: A button that recompiles the routine with debug information.

data.name: CompileForDebugPackage
data.value: TablePro compiles it again with debug information (PLSQL_OPTIMIZE_LEVEL=1) and keeps its other settings. Compiling commits. Other sessions using the package lose its state, and their next call to it fails once with ORA-04068.

data.name: ConnectionLost
data.value: The debug session's connection closed.

data.name: CouldNotFinishStep
data.value: The debugger couldn't finish this step.

data.name: CouldNotStart
data.value: The debugger couldn't start.

data.name: DebugFromCallerOverload
data.value: Debug it from a routine that calls it with arguments only this overload takes.

data.name: Ended
data.value: The debug session has ended.

data.name: GiveParameterValue
data.value: Give {0} a value. Left at its default, the call also matches another overload of {1}.
data.comment: {0} is a parameter name, {1} a subprogram name.

data.name: GiveParameterValues
data.value: Give {0} values. Left at their defaults, the call also matches another overload of {1}.
data.comment: {0} is a comma-separated list of parameter names, {1} a subprogram name.

data.name: GrantDebug
data.value: A DBA can grant it with GRANT DEBUG ON {0} TO {1}, or grant DEBUG ANY PROCEDURE.
data.comment: {0} is owner.name of a routine or package, {1} a user name. The GRANT statements are SQL.

data.name: GrantDebugConnectSession
data.value: A DBA can grant it with GRANT DEBUG CONNECT SESSION TO {0}.
data.comment: {0} is a user name. The GRANT statement is SQL.

data.name: HostBadCharacter
data.value: The host "{0}" holds a character Oracle connect descriptors do not allow.
data.comment: {0} is the host entered.

data.name: NeedsDebugConnectSession
data.value: Debugging needs the DEBUG CONNECT SESSION privilege.

data.name: NeedsDebugPrivilege
data.value: Debugging {0} needs the DEBUG privilege on it.
data.comment: {0} is owner.name of a routine or package.

data.name: NoEntryPoints
data.value: {0} has no public procedure or function to start from.
data.comment: {0} is a package name.

data.name: NotASessionId
data.value: "{0}" is not an Oracle session id of the form sid,serial#.
data.comment: {0} is the value given as a session id. sid,serial# is literal.

data.name: NotCompiledForDebug
data.value: {0} isn't compiled for debugging.
data.comment: {0} is a routine or package name.

data.name: OverloadDefaultUnreadable
data.value: Oracle can't tell the overloads apart without it (PLS-00307), and TablePro can't read the default to pass it.

data.name: RoutineFailed
data.value: The routine raised an error. Its changes were rolled back.

data.name: RunNote
data.value: Changes the routine makes are committed when it finishes. Stop rolls them back.

data.name: ServiceNameBadCharacter
data.value: The service name "{0}" holds a character Oracle connect descriptors do not allow.
data.comment: {0} is the service name entered.

data.name: SidBadCharacter
data.value: The SID "{0}" holds a character Oracle connect descriptors do not allow.
data.comment: {0} is the SID entered.

data.name: SourceUnreadable
data.value: TablePro can't read this unit's source.

data.name: StillRunning
data.value: TablePro couldn't confirm that the routine ended. It may still be running on the server.

data.name: StillRunningNoSession
data.value: Its uncommitted work rolls back when it ends. A user with ALTER SYSTEM can find its session in V$SESSION and end it with ALTER SYSTEM KILL SESSION.
data.comment: V$SESSION and ALTER SYSTEM KILL SESSION are SQL.

data.name: StillRunningSid
data.value: Session SID {0}. Its uncommitted work rolls back when it ends.
data.comment: {0} is the session SID.

data.name: StillRunningWithKill
data.value: Session SID {0}, SERIAL# {1}. Its uncommitted work rolls back when it ends. A user with ALTER SYSTEM can end it now with {2}.
data.comment: {0} is the session SID, {1} its SERIAL#, {2} the ALTER SYSTEM KILL SESSION statement that ends it.

data.name: Stopped
data.value: Stopped. The routine's changes were rolled back.

data.name: TextToType
data.value: TablePro can't turn text into a {0} value for {1}.
data.comment: {0} is a PL/SQL type name, {1} a parameter name.

data.name: TextToTypeDetail
data.value: Pass NULL or leave it at its default.

data.name: UnitUnreadable
data.value: TablePro can't read {0}. Check that this account can see its source.
data.comment: {0} is a routine or package name.

data.name: Unreadable
data.value: The database answered the debugger with data TablePro can't read.

data.name: UsingDbmsDebug
data.value: Debugging through DBMS_DEBUG.

data.name: ValueCollection
data.value: Collection
data.comment: Shown in the debugger in place of a collection's value.

data.name: ValueNotReadable
data.value: Not readable
data.comment: Shown in the debugger in place of a value it cannot read.
